data.narrative:
Together AI is a Series A-stage AI & Software company founded by Vipul Ved Prakash, Ce Zhang, Chris Ré, and Percy Liang, currently valued at $8.3B post-money on $530M raised. The valuation is benchmarked against a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), including frontier AI firms like Reflection AI, Figure AI, and Scale AI at similar or adjacent stages.

Two triangulation methods apply to this stage and sector. Stage-progression analysis, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yields $16.6B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B)—produces a median of $5.6B, with a range spanning $3.2B to $25.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity in frontier AI valuations at this stage.

Triangulating both methods supports a valuation range of $4.8B to $19.1B, with a median of $11.1B. The current $8.3B valuation sits within this range, slightly below the median. Key uncertainties include the relevance of the Reflection AI $25.0B outlier for a direct comparable and the stage-progression multiplier's applicability given the nascent, high-volatility nature of frontier AI venture stages. Additional revenue, burn rate, and market-share data would sharpen confidence in this range.
